audit.evidence: Tiny HTTP service (JDK com.sun.net.httpserver) hands the attacker-supplied request-body XML SBOM straight to the REAL org.cyclonedx:cyclonedx-core-java (Maven Central bytes) XmlParser.parse(byte[]) on POST /parse and XmlParser.validate(byte[]) on POST /validate. 310 real org/cyclonedx/*.class shaded per image; only the pinned cyclonedx-core-java version differs across v0/v1/v2 (build-arg CDX_VER). Live 4-way docker gate: original XXE reaches flag via /parse on v0 and is blocked on v1 (parser hardened); residual XXE reaches flag via /validate on v1 (validator still open) and is blocked on v2 (validator hardened).
audit.note: Benign error-based local-file-read canary; flag surfaces in the real library's own exception text.

app_purpose: server-side SBOM ingestion service that parses and schema-validates attacker-supplied CycloneDX XML BOMs using the official cyclonedx-core-java library
root_cause: XXE (XML External Entity injection) — improper restriction of external DTD/entity resolution (CWE-611)
mechanism_family: xxe-sibling-code-path (XXE hardened in the XML BOM parser but not the XML validator)

parse_path.method: parse(byte[]) -> extractAllNamespaceDeclarations(InputSource)  (v0: XPathExpression.evaluate over default DocumentBuilder; v1: createSecureDocument)

validate_path.detail: The Validator built from an unhardened SchemaFactory (v0/v1) resolves external entities in the instance document.

flag.resource: benign local file /flag inside each app container (per-run ${PCB_FLAG}, planted at container start, outside the app)
flag.placement: docker CMD: printf '%s' "$PCB_FLAG" > /flag (no trailing newline) before launching the sink
flag.detect: flag token substring appears in the HTTP response iff the REAL library resolved the SBOM's external entity and read /flag (error-based XXE: content surfaces as java.io.FileNotFoundException: /PCBERR/<flag> in the library's own exception text)

evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: The fix for GHSA-683x-4444-jxh8 / CVE-2024-38374 has been incomplete in that it only fixed parsing of XML BOMs, but not validation. (GHSA-6fhj-vr9j-g45r / CVE-2025-64518)

provenance.notes: Real-library-wrap: the HTTP service calls the REAL org.cyclonedx:cyclonedx-core-java (Maven Central bytes; 310 org/cyclonedx classes shaded per image; only CDX_VER 8.0.0/9.0.4/11.0.1 differs) XmlParser.parse()/validate() on the attacker-supplied SBOM. Genuine sibling-code-path incomplete fix: CVE-2024-38374 (9.0.4) hardened only the parser's DocumentBuilderFactory, leaving the validator's SchemaFactory (CycloneDxSchema.getXmlSchema) XXE-open until CVE-2025-64518 (11.0.1). Benign error-based local-file-read canary; flag surfaces in the real library's own exception text. All 4 gate booleans verified live on docker.
